<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$closure = function (string $value): string {
    return $value;
};
$staticClosure = static function (): void {};
$arrow = fn (int $value): int => $value;
$nullable = static fn (): ?string => null;
$captured = 'value';
$capturing = function () use ($captured): string|int {
    return $captured;
};
$intersection = fn (Countable&Iterator $value): Countable&Iterator => $value;
$dnf = fn ((Countable&Iterator)|null $value): (Countable&Iterator)|null => $value;
$nested = fn (): Closure => function (): int {
    return 1;
};
$reference = function &(string &$value): string {
    return $value;
};
$attributed = #[Deprecated] static fn (): string => 'value';
$compact = fn():int=>1;
$multiline = function ():
    string
{
    return 'value';
};
$commented = fn () /* before */: /* within */ int /* after */ => 1;
$lineComment = fn (): // Keep this comment.
    int => 1;
$hashComment = function (): # Keep this comment too.
    int {
    return 1;
};
$compoundComment = fn (): (Countable /* collection */ & Iterator)|null => null;
$untyped = fn (string $value) => $value;

function namedFunction(): string
{
    return 'value';
}

final class TypedMethods
{
    public function typedMethod(): string
    {
        return 'value';
    }
}
